_comment: LEIP distance model v3 — poster routes with EXACT ordered sequences (incl. returns to start and repeated ports) from the team Route Planner. published_nm is authoritative: exact-ordered-sequence match MUST output it.
_poster_routes_rule: If player's selected route EXACTLY matches a poster's ordered 'ports' sequence (including any repeated ports and return-to-start), output that route's published_nm. Detect exact ordered match.
_other_legs_rule: For non-poster routes, score each leg as matrix[a][b] × leg_correction.ratio[a][b].
_leg_correction_note: leg_correction.ratio is now cross-validated identical to the team's per-leg correction matrix in Game_Inputs.xlsx — same authority, not an approximation.

leg_correction._method: Visibility graph over 0.3° sea grid, Dijkstra shortest sea path, ports snapped to open water. Short legs (<15nm) verified individually: those whose straight line crosses land keep their computed detour ratio (they round real headlands, e.g. Bonifacio↔Porto Vecchio ×3.56); none needed clamping as no short leg was open-water-with-spurious-ratio.
